svg.title: Symbol variants B: engine nouns and structural marks
svg.desc: Five alternative treatments per concept, coded row-letter. Sheet A has verdicts and input devices.

g.inkscape:label: 00 Paper
g.text: Engine nouns and structural marks. Say the code, for example "13D".

g.inkscape:label: 99 Footer
g.text: Pick for the SET, not for the single mark. Entity, component and asset sit next to each other constantly and must not blur together.
